prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a hit while turning left. The patient had 20 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1451; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck on the driver side while turning left. The reported mechanism is consistent with the type and force of the impact, and the resulting wrist fracture is clearly confirmed on imaging and on examination. The patient's history includes a minor strain to the same region several years ago, which resolved completely without residual limitation. Over the course of approximately 20 office visits, care followed a typical progression of immobilization, supervised therapy, and graded return to activity. Visit frequency decreased steadily as function improved, and the patient was discharged from active treatment once goals were met. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges for each service rendered. Follow-up is recommended only if new symptoms arise.
